story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Existing date elements are identified and available for Facets transaction effective date population
gaps: Coverage gap for scenario TS_001 attached to TC_002: scenario description requires "2) Assessment Date is identified and can populate the transaction effective date in Facets." and the full acceptance criteria text for this scenario includes "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has already begun and the Assessment Date has changed, the Assessment Date populates as the transaction effective date." but TC_002 Pre-condition only states "the selected execution data must be the scenario where the Assessment Date is the value expected to populate the Facets transaction effective date." Add a dedicated test case for the explicit condition where "the member’s eligibility span has already begun and the Assessment Date has changed".

Coverage gap for scenario TS_001 attached to TC_003: scenario description requires "3) Maintenance Date is identified and can populate the transaction effective date in Facets." and the full acceptance criteria text for this scenario includes "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has already begun and any relevant fields have changed but Assessment Date has NOT changed, the Maintenance Date (DTP*303) populates as the transaction effective date." but TC_003 Pre-condition only states "the selected execution data must be the scenario where the Maintenance Date is the value expected to populate the Facets transaction effective date." Add a dedicated test case for the explicit condition where "the member’s eligibility span has already begun and any relevant fields have changed but Assessment Date has NOT changed".
